title: Easier sign-in and clearer photo scans

New: Add SafeDose to your home screen, with offline startup after an online visit.
Improved: Returning users can sign in from the welcome screen and go straight to the calculator.
When offline, camera entry takes you to the manual calculator with a visible notice.
Fixed: Failed photo scans show an error and preserve your entered values.
The progress counter reflects all seven steps, and calculated strength displays correctly.
Birth dates and ages entered during setup no longer appear in page URLs.
Dose results and popups no longer stay visible when you switch to Reference or Log.
Save no longer gets stuck after a canceled or failed sign-in, so you can try again.

title: Free calculator and optional Photo Check

Improved: Pricing now separates the free calculator from the optional Photo Check subscription.
Free accounts have the same allowance of three photo scans per month as guests.
